findings.finding: The reiterated FY2026 sales guide needs H2 net sales of EUR605-638m, +10.5% to +16.6% y/y on H2 2025's EUR547.6m, while H1 grew 7.5% reported and about 5% underlying once the EUR13m Actithiol upfront booked in Q2 is removed; Ebglyss, the main engine, was roughly flat sequentially Q1 to Q2 (EUR41.9m to ~EUR43m) against a FY expectation of EUR180-190m that requires ~EUR50m a quarter in H2 - so the 9M print is where the market tests whether the H2 acceleration has started, with a low-end-of-range sales steer the most plausible guidance change.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: FY25 results with the first FY26 guide (23 Feb 2026): close -6.1% (Yahoo daily bars). In-line Q1 2026 with reiterated guide (11 May 2026): -2.7% ('shares slip despite results meeting estimates'). H1 2026 with reiterated guide: +1.3%. 9M 2025 with reiterated guide: +1.9%.
findings.original_quote: La compañía ha reiterado sus previsiones financieras para 2026, con un crecimiento estimado de las ventas netas de entre el 9% y el 12%, y un EBITDA de entre 270 y 290M€. (The company reiterated its 2026 guidance: estimated net sales growth of 9-12% and EBITDA of EUR270-290m.) | R4: 'Los resultados incluyen 13 mln eur de upfront asociados a la desinversión de Actithiol más 1 mln eur adicional de ingresos. Excluyendo este efecto el crecimiento de las ventas es del +8% i.a.' (Results include EUR13m upfront from the Actithiol divestment plus EUR1m additional revenue; excluding it, sales growth is +8% y/y.)
findings.why_not_priced: The arithmetic is public, but the stock has run +10.3% in 20 sessions and +4.9% in 5 into the print, which is the opposite of what a market pricing a sales-guide trim would look like; broker framing (R4 'reiteran guía', company 'expecting growth to accelerate in H2') treats the guide as safe. Sized small because it is an inference from public numbers and the company itself guided the H2 acceleration.

findings.finding: Lilly, which owns lebrikizumab outside Almirall's European territory, reported Ebglyss Q3 2026 revenue of $202m, +59% y/y, and an implied sequential step-up from an H1 average of ~$173m a quarter, plus Phase 3 hand-and-foot atopic dermatitis data - a counterparty read that the molecule's demand is accelerating, though not Almirall's European sales.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Ebglyss beats have driven the dermatology narrative (Q1 2026 Ebglyss EUR41.9m vs R4e EUR39m) but the stock still fell 2.7% that day; no clean history of Lilly read-throughs moving ALM.
findings.why_not_priced: A US-market counterparty number that Spanish coverage does not read across; partly priced in the November rally (+5% in five sessions after 29 Oct). Proxy only: European uptake and pricing are separate, so sized small.
findings.independence: Lilly call: gaining share of new US specialty-derm prescriptions https://singjupost.com/eli-lilly-lly-q3-2026-earnings-call-transcript/ (snippet only)

findings.finding: The Q3 comparison base is demanding on EBITDA: Q3 2025 EBITDA was ~EUR58.9m (9M 2025 EUR180.7m less H1 2025 EUR121.8m), helped by a reduction in SG&A in that quarter, and the Actithiol upfront that flattered H1 2026 margins (ex it, H1 EBITDA margin 22.2%) does not recur, so Q3 EBITDA growth will print well below H1's +23.7%.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 2026 EBITDA -4.8% y/y but above consensus: stock -2.7%. Margin quality one-offs have been flagged by R4 ('más allá de extraordinarios positivos').
